# Synthetic. The server shuts the first session down in the middle of a
# command; the client must report an error and open a new session for the
# next operation.
=== connection
S: * OK ready
C: LOGIN *
S: {tag} OK Logged in
C: SELECT "INBOX"
S: * BYE Server shutting down for maintenance
=== connection
S: * OK ready
C: LOGIN *
S: {tag} OK Logged in
C: SELECT "INBOX"
S: * 1 EXISTS
S: {tag} OK [READ-WRITE] Select completed
C: UID STORE 7 +FLAGS.SILENT (\Flagged)
S: {tag} OK Store completed
